❖ In Q3 of 2020, the yields on short
term Government paper reduced
slightly.
❖ Interest rate on 91-days, 182-
days and 364-days Treasury bills
averaged 6.2%, 6.7% and 7.5%,
respectively in Q3 2020
compared to 6.5%, 7.2% and
9.2%, respectively during a
similar period in 2020.
❖ The average interbank rate also
fell to stand at 2.5% in Q3 2020
compared to 4.0% in a similar
period in 2019 indicating higher
liquidity in the money market.
